column1: # Expected checker output per case file, TAB-separated:
#   codes  : space-separated problem codes in order, or "-" for none
#   counts : optional assertion on how much was actually looked at, e.g.
#            Codes alone cannot tell "checked it and it was fine" from "never
#            looked" -- a case whose point is that something IS scanned (or is
#            NOT) has to pin the count too, or a regression to silence passes.
# A row may name a directory when the case is about how two files relate
# rather than one file on its own.
# scripts/selftest.sh asserts these exactly, and also fails if a file in
# tests/cases/ has no row here. A case file is a deliberately broken artifact;
# none of them live under study/ or points/, so `make check` never sees them.
